trend.title: Agentic commerce: The infrastructure is ready for AI agents. Is your store?
trend.rationale: The readiness of infrastructure for AI agents in commerce is crucial for businesses aiming to leverage AI for enhancing customer experience and operational efficiency. This trend is particularly relevant for retention marketing as AI can drive personalized engagements and improve customer satisfaction.
signals: AI agents becoming integral in retail operations
Need for businesses to adapt their infrastructure for AI deployment
Growing importance of AI in customer engagement strategies

evidence.claim: AI agents becoming integral in retail operations
evidence.support: Several large retailers have started integrating AI agents into their operations, such as chatbots for customer service and personalized marketing tools.

evidence.claim: Need for businesses to adapt their infrastructure for AI deployment
evidence.support: Reports indicate that businesses are investing in upgrading their IT infrastructure to support AI applications.

evidence.claim: Growing importance of AI in customer engagement strategies
evidence.support: AI is increasingly used for personalized marketing and customer engagement, with significant investments in AI-driven CRM systems.

statistics: Gartner predicts that by 2025, 60% of companies will have AI-augmented automation solutions for customer engagement.
A survey by McKinsey found that 31% of businesses have fully implemented AI in at least one function.
examples: Amazon's use of AI for personalized recommendations and customer service chatbots.
Zara's AI-driven inventory and customer preference management.
recent_news: Alibaba announced a new AI strategy focusing on customer experience enhancement through advanced AI agents.
risks: High implementation costs for small businesses.
Data privacy concerns with AI-driven customer engagement.
